[Highlight start] **After** drinking alcohol is generally the better time to have electrolytes [Highlight end] . Sipping water or an electrolyte drink alongside alcohol—and rehydrating afterward—helps replace fluid lost from alcohol's diuretic effect.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF12nPvQZ7buX3k8l8ATc859pzlQagYQUNKuounp37Qj5wLwTfLiwpQ6_TNh3g4-7gf59aLMbBehSRJQG0i26oafRz8nxAMDOPfT4vJ25UD1k90JVEcocGIwd6QHECThdmKDtRRfDgAq8Nf7sjMhLQ7mtIHfSn6WIbP78fDA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXUbAk7RXK6yLbd3aPfMEl_5bPwUBtnp2s7udsC9oEGMlSzScnpGArcV8IJfpjciSeO6yykvtaTzvUEJ3qZtAEggyO2K9XzaenkPHARZQ9D6qrJW7szw7WQK9Qju8kjlF2)

### What Electrolytes Actually Do

- **Ease dehydration symptoms:** Replenishing fluids and electrolytes can help with thirst, dry mouth, fatigue, and dehydration-related headaches.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXX-LcYTKx8CjZrgRmczs2WhFljqntzqzapDyqkhKvjcnzJ7aoViYFLLvWzBkY1mQRwhcC7vN-VwkuRwaCu4YllpnZThUjuqOcYcHAF4NDJukAOCfYaIGYHm12okFNjPAKogWRGojyDWg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXUbAk7RXK6yLbd3aPfMEl_5bPwUBtnp2s7udsC9oEGMlSzScnpGArcV8IJfpjciSeO6yykvtaTzvUEJ3qZtAEggyO2K9XzaenkPHARZQ9D6qrJW7szw7WQK9Qju8kjlF2)
- **Do not prevent or cure hangovers:** Electrolytes do not speed up how fast your body clears alcohol, nor do they stop inflammation and other non-dehydration drivers of a hangover. Only time and limiting or avoiding alcohol prevent hangovers.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXUbAk7RXK6yLbd3aPfMEl_5bPwUBtnp2s7udsC9oEGMlSzScnpGArcV8IJfpjciSeO6yykvtaTzvUEJ3qZtAEggyO2K9XzaenkPHARZQ9D6qrJW7szw7WQK9Qju8kjlF2)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXX-LcYTKx8CjZrgRmczs2WhFljqntzqzapDyqkhKvjcnzJ7aoViYFLLvWzBkY1mQRwhcC7vN-VwkuRwaCu4YllpnZThUjuqOcYcHAF4NDJukAOCfYaIGYHm12okFNjPAKogWRGojyDWg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF12nPvQZ7buX3k8l8ATc859pzlQagYQUNKuounp37Qj5wLwTfLiwpQ6_TNh3g4-7gf59aLMbBehSRJQG0i26oafRz8nxAMDOPfT4vJ25UD1k90JVEcocGIwd6QHECThdmKDtRRfDgAq8Nf7sjMhLQ7mtIHfSn6WIbP78fDA)
- **Pair with basics:** Eating food, getting rest, and sleeping matter more for recovery than electrolytes alone. You can find more details on timing and hangover myths in this [EatingWell](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF12nPvQZ7buX3k8l8ATc859pzlQagYQUNKuounp37Qj5wLwTfLiwpQ6_TNh3g4-7gf59aLMbBehSRJQG0i26oafRz8nxAMDOPfT4vJ25UD1k90JVEcocGIwd6QHECThdmKDtRRfDgAq8Nf7sjMhLQ7mtIHfSn6WIbP78fDA) breakdown.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF12nPvQZ7buX3k8l8ATc859pzlQagYQUNKuounp37Qj5wLwTfLiwpQ6_TNh3g4-7gf59aLMbBehSRJQG0i26oafRz8nxAMDOPfT4vJ25UD1k90JVEcocGIwd6QHECThdmKDtRRfDgAq8Nf7sjMhLQ7mtIHfSn6WIbP78fDA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXUbAk7RXK6yLbd3aPfMEl_5bPwUBtnp2s7udsC9oEGMlSzScnpGArcV8IJfpjciSeO6yykvtaTzvUEJ3qZtAEggyO2K9XzaenkPHARZQ9D6qrJW7szw7WQK9Qju8kjlF2)
